title: NOX METALS vs Clinton Aluminum for Aluminum Plate and Tooling
summary: Clinton Aluminum calls itself North America's largest aluminum mold plate distributor and holds ISO 9001:2015. NOX METALS gives you instant pricing and DFARS documentation on aerospace plate. Where each one is the right call.
body_markdown:
### Does Clinton Aluminum publish prices online?


No. Their site uses a Get a Quote flow with no cart or published pricing, which is the traditional service center model. If you want an instant published price on aerospace aluminum plate, that is what our quote tool does in under 60 seconds.


### Is ATP-5 the same as MIC-6?


They are largely equivalent cast tool and jig aluminum products from different mills, along with Alca5 and K100-S. All are precision-machined cast tooling plate chosen for dimensional stability and flatness rather than strength. Suppliers lead with whichever trade name they stock, so compare thickness, flatness tolerance, and surface finish rather than the brand.


### Does Clinton Aluminum stock 7050?


7050 is not featured in their public alloy lineup, which highlights 6061, 7075, 5000-series cast tool and jig, and 2000, 5000, and 7000-series mold plate. For 7050-T7451 to AMS 4050 you want a supplier that stocks aerospace plate as a core category.


### Are both companies ISO certified?


Yes, both Clinton Aluminum and NOX METALS hold ISO 9001:2015. Ours is published with scope at noxmetals.co/verified. ISO 9001 covers the quality management system and is separate from AS9100, which is the aerospace standard.


### Which is faster?


Clinton runs its own fleet with relay hubs from two facilities and claims among the fastest shipping in North America, but does not publish a lead time or a ship date. We commit to a per-line ship date at quote time and deliver nights and weekends. Speed you can schedule against is different from speed you are told about after ordering.
